scripts.dev:fix: lsof -ti :3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; rm -f .next/dev/lock; next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build
scripts.assets:video: ffmpeg -y -i public/p-shop-animation-source.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -crf 19 -preset slow -movflags +faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -an public/p-shop-animation-720.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i public/p-shop-animation-source.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -crf 18 -preset slow -movflags +faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -an public/p-shop-animation-1080.mp4 && cp public/p-shop-animation-720.mp4 public/p-shop-animation.mp4
